paragraphs: Dr Janet Hung is a Registered Occupational Therapist and the Director of Synergy Medical (ABN: 38 223 718 679), a government-approved vocational rehabilitation provider specializing in worker's compensation, motor vehicle accidents, and personal injury claims.
The organisation is dedicated to delivering high-quality, cost-effective injury management solutions, enabling clients to swiftly and securely resume their work and daily activities.

By focusing on a client-centred, highly individualized approach, Dr Hung and her team actively collaborate with other healthcare providers to eliminate barriers hindering a client's recovery and ensure a seamless transition back to daily life.

Comprehensive Services Offered: \- Workplace & Functional Assessments – Comprehensive evaluations to determine physical capacities and ergonomic safety. \- Vocational Assessments & Job Seeking Support – Tailored strategies to facilitate career transitions and re-entry into the workforce. \- Case Management Services – Person-centred support coordinating closely with medical practitioners and insurance bodies.

Specialised Clinical Frameworks: \- WorkCover Claims: Synergy Medical excels in managing workplace injury claims, assigning seasoned rehabilitation specialists to handle initial needs assessments, medical conferencing, and ergonomic evaluations. \- Third-Party Insurance (CTP): For individuals injured in motor vehicle accidents, Dr Hung designs personalized recovery strategies, actively collaborating with CTP insurers, doctors, and claimants to restore pre-injury lifestyles. \- NDIS Registered Services: As an NDIS provider, the team delivers various registered services, including Specialist Positive Behaviour Support, assist products for personal care/safety, and custom prostheses and orthoses. \- Work Health & Safety (WHS) Solutions: Offering expert consultations, virtual audits (via Zoom or FaceTime), and on-site workplace risk assessments to help businesses comply with the latest regulations and foster safer work environments.

Comprising a diverse team of multilingual health professionals,including accredited occupational therapists, rehabilitation counsellors, exercise physiologists, physiotherapists, and social workers,Synergy Medical remains deeply committed to the health, compliance, and long-term recovery of every client.
